stories.title: Lebanese villagers return to wrecked homes as the Israeli army pulls back
stories.description: In a pilot project in a village in southern Lebanon, Israeli forces have left and the Lebanese army moved it. But villagers who return find their houses wrecked.

stories.title: A grieving family in Lebanon returns to their village
stories.description: In Southern Lebanon, the Army is taking over after Israeli forces withdraw. One grieving family returns to their village to find almost everything in their house destroyed.

stories.title: 'I tell my son it's just fireworks': Life inside Yemeni city besieged by Houthis
stories.description: Orla Guerin speaks to seven people trapped in the key city of Taiz, cut off from the outside world for weeks.

stories.title: Kuwait says it repelled first Iranian attack in two months after US strikes island
stories.description: Bahrain says it was also attacked by Iran following a US air strike on the Iranian island of Qeshm in the Gulf on Tuesday.

stories.title: UK sanctions firms over Israeli West Bank settlements
stories.description: It marks the first sanctions since the UK announced a tougher approach to Israeli actions in the territory.

stories.title: Trump says US taking 'very seriously' any Iranian plot against Washington
stories.description: Tehran rejects any suggestion it was plotting a so-called dirty bomb attack on the US capital as "baseless".

stories.title: Houthi rebel advance in Yemen may further destabilise global economy
stories.description: The Iran-backed Houthis are gaining ground and their advance could have dangerous consequences, writes the BBC's security correspondent.

stories.title: Bahrain court sentences dozens of Shia Muslims to life in prison, activists say
stories.description: Most of those jailed on Iran-linked terrorism charges are clerics, a UK-based human rights group, claiming confessions were forced. Bahraini authorities accused the 69 unnamed defendants of establishing a terrorist group linked to Iran's Revolutionary Guards.

stories.title: Yemeni forces retreat to defend port city from Houthis
stories.description: Saudi-backed forces say they are moving troops from the Bab al-Mandab Strait to protect the interim capital, Aden.

stories.title: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack
stories.description: It marks the second attack on the country in three days and comes as the US and Iran remain locked in a stand-off over the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Israel investigates West Bank fires
stories.description: Israeli authorities have opened an investigation after Palestinian vehicles and properties were vandalised and set on fire in four villages in the occupied West Bank, in attacks local activists say were carried out by Israeli settlers. stories.title: Bahrain accuses Iran of striking industrial site as tankers hit in Hormuz
stories.description: Bahrain accused Iran of striking a civilian industrial site on Saturday evening, as two tankers were hit in the Strait of Hormuz. Tehran reported shooting down a US drone amid stalled efforts to end the war.

stories.title: ‘Horrific’ and ‘chilling’: Officials condemn ICE arrests at Seattle airport
stories.description: Video shows masked immigration agents forcibly detaining two people at Seattle airport, raising concerns over tactics.

stories.title: Pakistani among two injured in Iranian attacks, Bahrain says
stories.description: A Pakistani citizen was among two injured in last night’s Iranian attacks on Bahrain, authorities in the kingdom said on Sunday. stories.title: UK man swims in Strait of Hormuz to highlight environmental damage
stories.description: LONDON: A British endurance swimmer who swam in waters in the Strait of Hormuz to highlight the “devastating environmental consequences of war” on Saturday called for the waterway to be reopened and the pollution in it to be cleaned up. “Oil tankers, gas carriers and other mercha...

stories.title: At SCO moot in India, Musadik Malik declares climate change ‘enemy’ of civilisations
stories.description: Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik on Saturday declared climate change an “enemy” of civilisations as he highlighted its impact on South Asian countries at a meeting of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) in India. stories.title: Democrats won big in the US midterms. Now what?
stories.description: Democrats basking in their Nov 3 election wins will soon unveil an ambitious legislative agenda for the first 100 days and beyond, in a test of progressives’ influence and Republicans’ willingness to cooperate, as they take control of the US Congress on Jan 3. stories.title: Yemen’s Houthis launch strikes after Saudi coalition’s 'special operation'
stories.description: Yemen’s Houthis launched strikes on the Saudi capital Riyadh on Saturday, after vowing reprisals for a “special operation” by the Saudi-led coalition fighting them. Saudi Arabia has been battling a surge in attacks since fighting reignited in neighbouring Yemen’s civil war this s...

stories.title: Iran strike wounds two in Bahrain, Riyadh denounces ‘criminal’ attacks
stories.description: Bahrain said two people were wounded in an attack on “a civilian industrial site”, while Iran’s Revolutionary Guards said they targeted U.S. air defence systems.

stories.title: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted Houthi missile in western region
stories.description: Saudi Arabia's western region contains key energy infrastructure including the Yanbu terminal, a major facility for crude oil exports

stories.title: How U.S. controls flow of advanced tech, chip, and compute to China | Explained
stories.description: The U.S. Commerce Department on November 16 issued an interim final rule barring data centre operators outside the U.S. equipped with advanced American AI chips from providing cloud service to businesses in two dozen countries, including China, Iran, and Russia

stories.title: Iran wants diplomacy to end war, says Araghchi as U.S. rejects terms
stories.description: Tehran needs guarantees that Washington is serious about negotiations, says Iran’s Foreign Minister; highly enriched uranium should be kept inside Iran, he says, adding that ‘a fair solution’ could be reached; U.S. denies Iran fired at an F-16

stories.title: Iran says allies China, Russia oppose change in nuclear doctrine
stories.description: Iran has barred the International Atomic Energy Agency from inspecting its nuclear sites, citing security concerns and blaming the agency for failing to condemn U.S. and Israeli attacks on its nuclear facilities

stories.title: Iran-U.S. negotiations stalled over uranium enrichment dispute, mediators warn of renewed conflict, says reports
stories.description: The diplomatic deadlock comes amid continuing tensions between Washington and Tehran, with both countries yet to reach an understanding on the future of Iran's nuclear programme

stories.title: Trump says US, Iran continue indirect talks
stories.description: Qatar is acting as a mediator between the United States and Iran

stories.title: Trump inclined to resume strikes against Iran after New Year — TV
stories.description: Further strikes are possible if an agreement to end the conflict cannot be reached with Tehran, Fox News correspondent Trey Yingst said after his interview with the US leader
